risk.highAdvice: Humidity is very high. Inspect leaves and fruit closely, separate affected parts and follow the agriculture office's advice on prevention.
risk.mediumAdvice: Humidity is on the higher side. Wet leaves raise fungal risk, so water in the morning and at the plant base.
risk.lowAdvice: Low risk for now. Keep checking leaves regularly.

recs.riskCheck: Air humidity {{v}}%, disease risk {{level}}. Check leaves today.
recs.harvestSoon: {{name}}: harvest starts in {{n}} days. Arrange crates and sales.
recs.allOk: All good. Nothing needs doing today.

farm.autoOn: Auto mode on. The system will irrigate by itself below the threshold.
farm.manualOn: Manual mode on. You are in control now.

farm.watered: Watered. Moisture is up, tank is down.
farm.noWaterClosedValves: No watering — valves are closed. Turn a valve on first.
farm.serverCmdFailed: Could not send the command to the server.
farm.serverSaveFailed: Could not save on the server.

overview.forecastNote: Sample data. Real forecasts arrive once a weather service is connected.
overview.moist24hNote: Sample data. The dashed line is the irrigation threshold.
overview.moist24hLiveNote: From the server’s telemetry. The dashed line is the irrigation threshold.

irrigation.title: Pump & mode
irrigation.thresholdHint: Auto irrigation starts below this moisture
irrigation.durationHint: The pump runs at most this long
irrigation.zonesNote: A closed valve is skipped during auto irrigation.
irrigation.rulesNote: When a condition matches, the system decides on its own.

fields.noFields: No fields yet. Add one with the form below.
fields.name: Field name
fields.harvestNote: Harvest day varies by variety and season. Use your own variety's figure.
fields.scoutNote: Note down pests, disease or anything unusual you spot.
fields.notePlaceholder: e.g. Spots on lower leaves in Zone C

finance.lossNote: In loss so far; selling more produce will turn it around

inventory.name: Name
inventory.useNote: Enter how much you used — stock goes down. With a cost, the expense is booked to that field.

analytics.sampleChartNote: This chart is drawn from sample data.
analytics.dashMark: The dashed line is the irrigation threshold.
analytics.driestInsight: The driest zone right now is {{zone}} ({{v}}%). Check that zone's pipes and sensor placement.
analytics.perPlantInsight: Daily average water per plant is {{n}} liters. This should change with the crop's stage.
analytics.avgMoistureInsight: Average moisture across zones is {{n}}%. This analysis uses sample data; with real sensors it will show your own farm's trends.

settings.demoModeNote: Sensor readings change on their own and the irrigation rules run. Turn it off before connecting real devices.
settings.teamNote: Owners can change everything, operators run irrigation and tasks, viewers only read — enforced on the server.
settings.notifNote: SMS and Telegram are sent by the server (when it has a gateway/bot configured); app notifications and WhatsApp aren't wired yet.
settings.ossSourceValue: The GitHub repository this app was built from.
settings.ossSelfHostValue: The goal is to run on a Raspberry Pi or small VPS so the data stays in your hands.
settings.locationNote: Latitude/longitude for the forecast and the rain-skip rule (owner).
settings.maxDailyNote: Auto mode will not run the pump past this, so a faulty sensor or rule cannot drain the tank. 0 = no limit.
settings.contactNote: Alerts and the weekly summary are sent here. SMS/Telegram must be on under notifications.

connect.tagline: Irrigation, fields, tasks and money — all in your palm.
connect.serverHint: Start the Farm Command server and enter its address, e.g. http://192.168.0.5:8082
connect.noServerBody:
From the repo's root folder on your computer:
docker compose up -d --build
Then connect using the computer's IP. Phone and server must be on the same network. On the Android emulator use http://10.0.2.2:8082.

conn.timeout: The server is taking too long to respond.

analytics.noTelemetry: No telemetry in this window. Send data from a device or simulator and the charts will appear.
analytics.avgMoistureLive: Average moisture across zones is {{n}}%. The charts are drawn from telemetry stored on the server.

devices.demoNote: Connect to a server to see real device status and commands; a sample list is shown for now.
devices.relayOn: Relay turned on. Pump mode is now manual.

offline.queued: No connection — saved, and it will be sent when you are back online
offline.sent: {{n}} saved entries sent to the server
offline.dropped: The server rejected a saved entry, so it was dropped

harvest.title: Harvest
harvest.note: Record each picking. Litres per kg is the number that shows whether the system is saving water.
harvest.addIncome: Also add the sale to the ledger
harvest.noZone: Link this field to a zone to track its water
harvest.flowMissing: Set the pump flow in Settings, otherwise litres show as 0.
harvest.flowNote: Time how long the pump takes to fill a bucket of known size, then divide. All water figures use this number.

advice.note: A score from season, rotation, water and market price. Read the reasons — the decision is yours.
advice.plantNote: The field's crop changes, its age restarts and the crop's jobs are added with dates.

fieldProfit.title: Profit by field
fieldProfit.note: Pick a field when you record an expense or income and it shows up here.

weekly.title: This week
weekly.note: The last 7 days. Every Friday morning it also goes to your phone.
weekly.flowUnknown: Pump ran {{runs}} times — set the pump flow in Settings to see litres
